description: Candle-lighting and havdalah times for the coming (or a specified) Shabbat and any Yom Tov that week, plus the parsha and holiday Torah readings, for a location.

candle_minutes.description: Minutes before sunset for candle lighting (default 18; 40 for Jerusalem).

date.description: Any date in the week you want (defaults to this week).

havdalah_minutes.description: Havdalah N minutes after sunset; default is nightfall (tzeit, 8.5°).

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with longitude + timezone instead of location).

location.description: Where the user is. A US ZIP code ("11691"), a city name ("Jerusalem", "London", "Lakewood, NJ"), or a numeric place id returned by find_location. Omit to use the server default.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, required with latitude/longitude, e.g. "America/New_York".

name: get_shabbat_times
title: Shabbat & Yom Tov times
